subject: Report not showing data for the last day of measurement

messages.author: a3527f6489543e9b
messages.subject: Report not showing data for the last day of measurement
parts:
Hi all,

I am facing some issues with the GENEActiv data analysis where the reports generated did not show any data for the last day of measurements. I initialized the monitor to record movement for 7 days and as you can see from the graph it did record activities on Day 7; however the excel reports (both Part2 and Part5) did not have anything for that particular day. I never had this problem before and am not sure what could be the issue. I am now using GGIR 1.9-2 and below is my script:




g.shell.GGIR(#=======================================
             #INPUT NEEDED:
             mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
             datadir="C:/Users/khc745/Documents/PhD_GENEActiv/Baseline/Data",
             outputdir="C:/Users/khc745/Documents/PhD_GENEActiv/Baseline/Results_M",
             f0=1, f1=12,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 1:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: reading file, auto-calibration, and extracting features
             do.enmo = TRUE, do.anglez=TRUE,desiredtz="Australia/NSW",
             chunksize=1, printsummary=TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 2:
             #-------------------------------
             strategy = 2, 
             includedaycrit = 16,
             qwindow=c(0,24),
             mvpathreshold =c(192),
             bout.metric = 4,
             closedbout=FALSE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 3:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Sleep detection
             timethreshold= c(5), anglethreshold=5,
             ignorenonwear = TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 4:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Integrating sleep log (if available) with sleep detection
             # storing day and person specific summaries of sleep
             excludefirstlast = FALSE,
             includenightcrit = 16,
             def.noc.sleep = c(1),
      
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 5:
             # Key functions: Merging physical activity with sleep analyses
             #-------------------------------
             threshold.lig = c(52), threshold.mod = c(192), threshold.vig = c(696),
             boutcriter = 0.8, boutcriter.in = 0.9, boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1), timewindow = c("MM"),
             #-----------------------------------
             # Report generation
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Generating reports based on meta-data
             do.report=c(2,4,5),
             visualreport=TRUE, dofirstpage = TRUE,
             viewingwindow=1)

Vincent

parts:
Hi Vincent,

Thanks for your input. I had trouble updating the GGIR with my R programme - the version that I have now is 1.10-1.
I am still having the same problem i.e. not having any data reported for the last of measurements in any of the outputs (part2, part4). For part2, I could still see the Day 7 in the "Day column" but no data at all. Whereas for Part4 it only includes data up to night6 (see below screenshot):



I tried to change the value for includenightcrit (from 16 to 6) and includedaycri (from 16 to 10) as per your advice but it didn't change the output. 

I initialised the monitors to record measurements for 7 days (from midnight Day 1); so the last day (Day7) was supposed to be recorded until 11.59pm. Could it be that GGIR does not see that as a valid day? I set excludefirstlastnight as FALSE and remove the maxdur option but it still didn't change the output. 

Best regards,

Kar-Hau, Chong (John)
